definitions.explanation: A long pole used for catching fish, typically with a line, reel, and hook attached.

examples.japanese: カーボン{製|せい}の{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a carbon fiber fishing rod.

examples.japanese: {釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}を{持|も}って{川|かわ}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to the river with my fishing rod.

examples.japanese: {初心者|しょしんしゃ}{向|む}けの{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}セットがある。
examples.english: There are fishing rod sets for beginners.

notes:
FORMATION:
{釣|つ}り (fishing) + {竿|さお}→ざお (pole/rod)

Note: {竿|さお} becomes {竿|ざお} (rendaku) in this compound.

TYPES:
・のべ{竿|ざお} (fixed rod without reel)
・リール{竿|ざお} (rod with reel)
・{投|な}げ{竿|ざお} (casting rod)
・ルアーロッド (lure rod)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}を{振|ふ}る (to cast a fishing rod)
・{釣|つ}り{竿|ざお}をしまう (to put away a fishing rod)
